initialExam.title: APTET 2026 (Andhra Pradesh TET)
initialExam.conductingBody: Department of School Education, Andhra Pradesh
initialExam.description: Andhra Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test for recruitment of teachers in AP government and private schools.
initialExam.qualifications: Teaching qualification as per NCTE norms
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I (SGT): Child Development, Telugu, English, Math, EVS. Paper II (SA): Child Development, Languages, Subject. Paper III (Language): Content, Methodology.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 150 marks, 2.5 hrs. Paper II: 150 marks, 2.5 hrs.
initialExam.jobRole: SGT and School Assistant in AP schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: SGT → School Assistant → Head Master → MEO → DEO.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit aptet.apcfss.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
